title: Meereis-Albedo-Sandbox — Arctic vs. Antarctic interactive sea-ice albedo feedback
description: Interactive Arctic vs. Antarctic sea-ice albedo feedback sandbox, using published constants from GenesisAeon's arctic-climate-utac (P127) and antarctic-ice-shelf-utac (P120): Duspayev et al. 2024 (sea-ice radiative effect), Zhang et al. 2025 (ice-albedo feedback factor gamma_IA = 0.41), and Riihelä et al. 2021 (the real Antarctic sign-flip, -0.06 to +0.26 W/m2). Year-by-year ice-extent curves are explicitly labelled as a schematic reconstruction calibrated to the published summary statistics, not satellite raw data. No UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge. Part of the GenesisAeon interactive-sandbox series.
